cup.replace: Replace this unfinished cup? Completed trophies and statistics stay saved.
cup.abandon_confirm: Abandon this cup? Completed trophies and statistics stay saved.
cup.old_version: This cup uses an older game version. Start a new cup.
settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.name: Display name
data.local_identity_help: Your guest identity stays on this device. Resetting all local data loses it. There is no account recovery.
data.local_identity_help_android: Your saves and guest identity stay on this device. Uninstalling the app or resetting all local data removes them. There is no account recovery.
data.deletion_help: Online data deletion requests go to the selected region's operator. Local records and saves are separate.
data.deletion_select_region: Open Play Online and select an available region first, then return here.
data.deletion_confirm: Send an online data deletion request to %s? This records your request for that regional operator. Data remains until the operator fulfills it; local saves stay available.
data.deletion_second: Confirm sending this regional online-data deletion request once more. The operator must fulfill the request; this does not reset local saves.
data.deletion_pending: Request recorded; pending operator action. Receipt: %s
data.deletion_no_identity: No existing online identity is registered with this region. A new identity was not registered for this request.
settings.reset_records_confirm: Delete personal times, ghosts and trophies? Settings and guest identity stay saved.
settings.reset_all_confirm: Delete all local game data? This also loses your guest identity and active cup.
settings.controls_help: Keyboard: W/A/S/D or arrows. Brake: S. Slide: Space. Recover: hold R. Camera: C. Look back: V. Pause: Escape.
data.save_failed: Couldn't save — free space and retry.
data.newer_schema: Data from a newer game version is read-only. Back up or reset that component.
data.invalid_payload: This data could not be saved.
data.backup_restored: A damaged save was restored from its backup.
data.corrupt_defaults: A damaged save was preserved. Defaults were restored for that component.
data.ghost_unavailable: The previous ghost could not be loaded. Your time record is preserved.
pause.title: PAUSED
pause.leave_confirm: Leave this race? Your result will be DNF.
pause.offline_confirm: Leave this race? Current race progress will be lost.
hud.invalid: Invalid run — retry to set a record.
results.title: RACE RESULTS
results.name: Racer
results.invalid: Invalid run • no record or medal
school.title: DRIVING SCHOOL
school.final_body: Try a race, or keep exploring at your own pace.
school.0: Accelerate, then brake to a stop.
school.1: Steer through the three broad turn markers.
school.3: Hold a short slide, then release it.
school.4: Hold Recover to return to the road.
online.title: PLAY ONLINE
online.empty: No open rooms. Create one or use Quick Join.
online.unavailable: Can't reach the room service. Offline modes and Direct Connect are still available.
online.address_error: Enter hostname:port or [IPv6]:port. Port must be 1–65535.
online.timeout: Connection timed out — Retry or Back
online.kick_confirm: Kick this player from the room?
online.abandoned: Server connection lost — race result not recorded.
credits.title: CREDITS
credits.creator: Original game and procedural assets: Pacific Rush contributors.
credits.fonts: Barlow, Barlow Condensed and Noto Color Emoji • SIL Open Font License 1.1
credits.inspiration: Inspired by colorful arcade racers of the late 1990s. No affiliation with their creators.
credits.licenses: Complete redistribution notices are included with the game.
control.capture: Press a key or gamepad control. Escape cancels.
control.keep_essential: Confirm and Back must keep a keyboard binding.
route.description.palm_bay: A compact coast loop of long, gentle bends past the headland, pier and beach promenade.
route.description.citrus_pass: Loose-clay orchard rally: flowing bends, changing hills and two jumps between fruit groves.
route.description.marina_lights: Downtown after dark: long boulevards, hard braking and sharp block corners.
route.description.redwood_run: Narrow forest dirt rally: linked left-right bends and a timber jump.
route.description.sunstone_canyon: Desert dirt stadium: three jumps, broad sweepers and a twisting infield.
route.description.pacific_summit: Mountain rollercoaster: huge climbs, plunging drops and three launches.
online.ready_required: Every racer must be ready before Start.
online.code_error: Use the eight letters and digits in the room code.
touch.screen_small: This screen is too small for touch driving. Use a landscape safe area at least 320 points high.
display.confirm_seconds: Keep these display settings? Reverting in %d seconds.
binding.title: Remap Controls
binding.defaults_confirm: Restore the default bindings for this device?
binding.capture:
Press a key, button or move an axis.
Esc / View / Share cancels. %d seconds left.
binding.timed_out: No binding changed. Capture timed out.
binding.essential: Confirm and Back each need at least one keyboard binding.
binding.conflict: Already assigned to %s. Swap the two bindings, replace that binding, or cancel?
data.continue_unsaved_help: Retry Save keeps this result. Continue Without Saving dismisses the save error for this race.
data.cup_unsaved: This Cup cannot advance from these results until saving completes. Continue Without Saving returns to the menu; Continue Cup resumes the last saved event checkpoint.
data.pending_results: Couldn't save %d result(s). They are kept in memory for Retry Save until you quit or dismiss them.
data.dismiss_results_confirm: Stop retrying these unsaved results? Any changes that have not reached disk will be lost.
data.quit_unsaved: Quit with unsaved results? Any changes that have not reached disk will be lost.
touch.layout_reset: Your saved touch layout could not fit this safe area. The default layout has been restored.
touch.editor_help: Drag controls, or Confirm to move with directions.
touch.editor_nudge: Directions move by 8 points. Back stops moving.
touch.editor_invalid: Controls overlap or leave the safe area. Move the red outlines apart.
online.room_name_error: Use 3–24 characters without markup or line breaks.
online.waiting_service: Finding your place on the grid…
online.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then retry.
online.identity_unavailable: Your saved guest identity is unavailable. Retry after unlocking its protected storage, or use offline play and Direct Connect.
online.storage_busy: Guest storage is still finishing. Wait a moment, then retry.
online.session_only: Guest storage is unavailable. This guest identity will last for this session only.
online.capacity: The room service is busy. Please try again soon.
loading.hint_brake: Brake before the corner, then accelerate through the exit.
loading.hint_slide: Steer fully at speed to drift, or hold Slide. Ease off to regain grip.
loading.hint_recover: Hold Recover for half a second to rejoin the road near your place in the race.
loading.hint_look: Look ahead along the road; the minimap shows the complete circuit.
loading.left_room: You left the room during loading. Join another room to race.
hud.recover_again: Press Recover again to confirm. Back or Pause cancels.
diagnostics.choose: Choose where to save the diagnostics ZIP.
diagnostics.unavailable: The system save dialog is unavailable. Try again later.
diagnostics.failed: Could not save diagnostics. Choose a location and try again.
display.resolution_help: Windowed: resolution sets window pixels and fits the work area. Fullscreen: resolution sets world pixels; the HUD uses the desktop resolution. Native uses the current size. The desktop display mode stays unchanged.
network.detail: Last 5 seconds: RTT %s · snapshot delivery loss %s%%
installation.title: Installation incomplete
installation.body: Required game content is missing: %s. Reinstall the game, then retry. You can export diagnostics for a bug report.
help.menu.online: Find a room, host a race, or connect directly to a server.
help.menu.quick: Choose a car, course and opponents for one race.
help.menu.trial: Set a clean one-lap time and race your saved ghost.
help.menu.cup: Race all six courses and carry your points to the next event.
help.menu.school: Try five short driving exercises at your own pace.
help.menu.garage: Choose one of four cars and eight paint colors.
help.menu.settings: Adjust display, sound, controls and accessibility.
help.menu.credits: View original asset credits, software and licenses.
help.setting.render_scale: Adjust the 3D image resolution. Menus and the HUD stay sharp.
help.setting.retro: Use a fixed 640×360 world image with a sharp native-resolution HUD.
help.setting.effects: Choose Full, Reduced, or Off for tire smoke, dust, sparks and skid marks.
help.setting.reduce_motion: Keep the camera field of view fixed, remove shake and cut menu transitions instantly.
help.setting.dynamic_fov: Widen the view as speed rises. Reduce Motion keeps the view fixed.
help.setting.camera: Near follows closely; Far shows more road; Hood places the view at the windshield.
help.setting.nameplates: Show up to four visible rivals between 8 and 80 meters away.
help.setting.trial_ghost: Show your best saved run for the same car and course. It has no contact.
help.setting.hold_assistance: Use a second fresh Recover press instead of holding. Back or Pause cancels.
help.setting.captions: Show announcer cues as text, including when the announcer volume is zero.
help.setting.haptics: Use short touch confirmation and collision vibrations when the device supports them.
help.setting.touch_auto_accelerate: Accelerate after GO without holding a pedal. Brake still slows the car.
help.setting.ui_scale: Increase text and menu controls. Scrolling keeps required actions reachable.
help.setting.audio_range: Night reduces loud peaks while keeping quiet details audible.
ui.wait: Please wait for this operation to finish.
online.room_not_joinable: This room is full or has already started. Choose an available lobby.
school.4_assisted: Press Recover twice to return to the road.
data.profile_busy: Another Pacific Rush process is using this profile. This session cannot save changes.
resume.title: RESUME YOUR RACE
resume.trial_body: A Time Trial interrupted by closing the game starts again from the grid.
resume.incompatible: This saved race uses a different game version or an unavailable Cup. Discard it to start a new race.
pause.audio_interrupted: Audio is interrupted. Resume when it is available again.
online.cellular_notice: Online races use mobile data. Continue?
loading.graphics_failed: Graphics preparation failed. Retry or Cancel.
route.description.skyline_splice: Harbor towers, a huge climb, and a flying figure-eight crossing.
route.description.quarry_switchback: Linked hairpins, rocky drops, log piles, and roaring waterfalls.
route.description.spillway_sprint: A three-loop waterworks knot over turquoise reservoirs and cascading dam arches.
route.description.caldera_crosscut: Alien volcanic moon: neon speed gates and seven sky-high crossings under a ringed planet.
online.iroh_code_help: Enter the four-character code from a Pacific Rush host.
online.iroh_code_error: Enter a four-character room code using the letters and numbers shown by the host.
online.iroh_unavailable: Code multiplayer is unavailable on this device.
online.iroh_incompatible: This code belongs to another game or version. Use matching Pacific Rush builds.
online.iroh_service_error: Could not contact the code service. Check your connection and try again.
online.iroh_rate_limit: The code service is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
online.iroh_expired: That code has expired or is unavailable. Ask the host for a new code.
online.iroh_host_help: You keep this room running. Leaving or backgrounding on Android closes the room. Codes last 10 minutes; connected racers can keep playing.
online.iroh_host_closed: The host closed this room. Return to Online to join or host another room.
online.iroh_host_background: Hosting stopped while the app was in the background. Create a new room to race again.
route.description.glacier_ridge: Climb through flowing ice-blue bends, curl around the summit and dive beneath the glacier gallery.
route.description.aurora_harbor: Brake for offset wharf chicanes, then stretch out beside polar cranes under the aurora.
route.description.alpine_meadow: A short dirt clover of linked sweepers, flower slopes and a moving chairlift overhead.
route.description.frostbite_fjord: Long fjord-side arcs curl into an inland reversal, with frozen falls beyond the road.
route.description.tundra_pipeline: A broad tundra dirt run with open utility-road sweepers, low hills and a huge pipe crossing.
route.description.rainforest_ruins: Weave through flowing jungle bends, rounded temple loops and a towering stone portal.
route.description.monsoon_delta: Link broad river esses around reed islands and a working sluice beneath storm-blue skies.
route.description.coral_causeway: A long chain of open island sweepers, turquoise water and giant coral hoops.
route.description.mangrove_maze: Link dirt bends around sheltered mangrove pockets and a tangled root bridge.
route.description.cloudforest_climb: Two big dirt climbs join rolling jungle esses, fern slopes and a falling canopy cascade.
route.description.sakura_ring: A short garden circuit of curving lobes and quick direction changes beneath swaying lanterns.
route.description.bamboo_gorge: Carry a rhythm through compact dirt esses, bamboo groves and a high suspension walkway.
route.description.lantern_market: Short city blocks demand quick braking before a long avenue beneath glowing market roofs.
route.description.terrace_touge: A broad mountain climb folds into tight hairpins before a rolling descent past tea terraces.
route.description.temple_coast: A broad coastal sweep curls into a tight inner loop beneath a gently swinging temple bell.
route.description.saltflat_velocity: The longest lap: huge salt-flat straights, hard braking zones and a land-speed timing gantry.
route.description.dune_serpent: A long chain of rolling dirt esses, a dune-crest launch and enormous fossil ribs.
route.description.oasis_citadel: Broad garden arcs tighten into palace bends beneath a turquoise aqueduct and sandstone domes.
route.description.copper_mesa: A long dirt mesa circuit mixes tight switchbacks with broad outer arcs and moving ore overhead.
route.description.storm_chase: A fast prairie loop of gentle bends and low rises beneath a turning funnel and storm shelf.
route.description.steelworks_sprint: Thread a tight loading-yard zigzag between fast industrial straights and a towering blast furnace.
route.description.container_corkscrew: Repeated dock fingers test braking and exits before the long harbor run under a container lift.
route.description.neon_underpass: Flowing city bends pass distinct blocks, lit street sections and a moving overhead metro.
route.description.windfarm_run: Broad dirt ridge sweepers tighten and open again beside ranks of turning wind turbines.
route.description.festival_speedway: Flowing stadium bends curl through a compact infield beside striped stalls and a turning wheel.
route.description.lunar_freight: Long crater arcs wind into an inner loop past one freight base, a survey outpost and a giant rocket.
route.description.orbital_gardens: Long orbital sweepers curl into habitat-bowl esses beneath an armillary and a ringed giant.
route.description.crystal_chasm: Long dirt sweepers feed a tight chasm hairpin and linked reversals beneath a huge geode arch.
route.description.mars_badlands: Rolling canyon esses, two dirt launches and a high bridge beneath dusty Martian skies.
route.description.reactor_rift: Alternating reactor bends rise and fall beside turning containment rings and an eclipse.
